meals.name: ALDI Chicken Thigh Greek Farro Bowls
meals.macroFit: Trim visible fat and keep chicken to about 5 oz per person; farro, chickpeas, and vegetables add fiber without heavy sauces.
instructions: Cook farro according to package directions while chicken cooks.
Trim chicken thighs and season with oregano, garlic, pepper, paprika, and lemon.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through; rest and slice.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and spinach; rinse chickpeas.
Build bowls with farro, chickpeas, vegetables, chicken, lemon juice, and a spoon of Greek yogurt if desired.

meals.name: HT EZ Peel Shrimp Brown Rice Skillet
meals.protein: Farm Raised EZ Peel White Shrimp, 2 lb bag
meals.macroFit: Shrimp is lean, so the plate stays macro-friendly with brown rice and a large vegetable base.
instructions: Thaw and peel shrimp if needed; pat dry.
Warm brown rice pouches while chopping vegetables.
Sauté zucchini and peppers with garlic, smoked paprika, and pepper until crisp-tender.
Add shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until opaque; fold in spinach and tomatoes.
Serve over brown rice with lime and parsley or cilantro.

meals.name: ALDI Chicken Breast Quinoa Primavera
meals.macroFit: Chicken breast is lean enough to support a higher-protein dinner while quinoa and vegetables keep carbs complex.
instructions: Cook quinoa while prepping the chicken and vegetables.
Slice chicken thin and season with garlic, Italian seasoning, pepper, and lemon zest.
Sear chicken strips 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through; remove from pan.
Sauté broccoli, zucchini, and carrots until crisp-tender, then wilt in spinach.
Toss quinoa, vegetables, chicken, lemon juice, and a drizzle of olive oil.

meals.name: ALDI Pork Chop Apple Sweet Potato Plates
meals.macroFit: Use trimmed 5 oz pork portions and build the plate around green vegetables and sweet potatoes instead of heavy sauces.
instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes until tender, turning once halfway through.
Pat pork dry and season with garlic, pepper, smoked paprika, and a thin swipe of Dijon.
Sear pork chops 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through; rest and slice into portions.
Sauté green beans and kale until crisp-tender.
Serve pork with sweet potatoes, greens, sliced apples, and a quick vinegar-Dijon slaw.

meals.name: ALDI Salmon Lentil Veggie Plates
meals.vegetable: Asparagus or green beans, spinach, tomatoes
meals.macroFit: A 5 oz salmon portion brings omega-3 fats; lentils and potatoes keep the carb side whole-food and filling.
instructions: Microwave or air-fry halved baby potatoes until tender and browned.
Cut salmon side into portions and season with lemon, pepper, garlic, and dill or parsley.
Sear salmon skin-side down, then flip and cook until just opaque, about 8 to 10 minutes total.
Steam or sauté green beans; warm lentils with spinach and tomatoes.
Plate lentils, potatoes, vegetables, and salmon with lemon.

meals.name: HT Ribeye Fajita Brown Rice Bowls
meals.macroFit: Use 4 oz sliced steak per person and make the bowl mostly vegetables, beans, and brown rice.
instructions: Slice peppers and onions; warm brown rice and rinsed pinto beans.
Season steak with cumin, chili powder, garlic, pepper, and lime.
Sear steak 3 to 4 minutes per side, rest, then slice thin.
Sauté peppers and onions in the same pan until tender-crisp.
Build bowls with rice, beans, fajita vegetables, romaine, tomatoes, and sliced steak.
